text:
maya_sales: Hey team — ACME (Alex) is ready to kick off a 4-week POC next week. Ask: can we provision a POC workspace, provide hosted API keys for app devs, and also a small Dedicated pool for load tests? Need least-privilege invites for their engineers + a security contact to complete questionnaire.

sam_se: Quick q — do they need Private/VPC or is hosted + Dedicated enough? Also what models/throughput do they expect?

customer_alex: Hosted + Dedicated is fine for now. We'll run dev + scale tests. Target peak ~150 rps for a few minutes. Our SRE will want logs and ability to roll model versions (read-only for some users).

jules_sec: For security: prefer short-lived API keys (7d) for POC, enforce MFA on any admin invites, enable IP allowlist for hosted keys if they can. If we do Dedicated and they want logs, only provide access to ingestion/usage logs, not host-level metrics. Also need to add security@acme to the questionnaire.

aaron_infra: I can carve out a small Dedicated pool for 4 weeks — recommend "POC-dedicated-small" (2 GPUs) to hit 150 rps with typical LLMs. Need PO number and cost center to schedule. Steps I'll do once approved:
1) Create workspace: Redwood Console > Org > Workspaces > Create
2) Create roles & invites (see below)
3) Provision Dedicated pool and attach to workspace
4) Generate short-lived hosted API key(s) and scope them

sam_se: Suggested minimal RBAC mapping (apply on workspace level):
```
POC-Admin: [invite users, manage keys, attach pools, view billing]
POC-Engineer: [create API keys (scoped), start/stop jobs, view logs]
POC-Observer: [read-only: metrics, traces, model versions]
```
Make sure POC-Engineer cannot change workspace billing or remove Dedicated pools.

jules_sec: Add these controls please:
- API keys default TTL 7 days; rotate via Console or API
- Disable key creation for Observer role
- Enable audit logs export to their S3 for retention

maya_sales: I'll get PO and cost center from procurement today. Alex — can you confirm security@acme and SRE email for invites?

customer_alex: security@acme-secure.com and sre-oncall@acme.com. Also: can SRE get model-switching permission but not billing?

sam_se: Yes — add a scoped permission "model.switch" to POC-Engineer (no billing). Example invite note: "Role: POC-Engineer (model.switch allowed, billing:false)"

aaron_infra: On my side I'll prepare the invite flow. Console shortcuts for internal ops: Settings > API Keys > Create (set TTL), Workspace > Access > Invites > Add (email + role). For audit: we'll enable export: Console > Org > Audit Logs > Create export (S3).

provision-bot: [system] 1764123505 — Dedicated pool "POC-dedicated-small" scheduled for provisioning (ETA 2h) :white_check_mark:

maya_sales: Thanks — I'll send procurement PO this afternoon and CC security. Will loop back once PO number is in. :thumbsup:
